equipment_type: Pressure-independent control valve with energy meter
applies_to: Belimo Energy Valve version 4, DN 15 to 50, BACnet models EV..R2+(K)BAC, EV..R2+MID and EV..R3+BAC.
summary: The Energy Valve V4 is a pressure-independent characterized control valve with an ultrasonic flow sensor and two temperature sensors, so it reports flow, delta T, power and heating/cooling energy. It speaks BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP (including foreign-device registration). The setpoint on AO 1 means position, flow, power or differential pressure depending on the control mode in MV 100, and the engineering units of most analog objects follow selectable unit objects.
notes: Version 1-3 Energy Valves use a different object list; this file covers V4 only.
Units of flow, power, energy, volume, temperature and pressure objects follow the unit-select MVs 123-131 and can change.
MV 200 selects the certified (MID models only) or lifetime meter register for the energy and volume objects.
Sensor 1 objects (AI 20/21, AV 20, BI 20) are out of service unless MV 220/221 select the matching sensor type.
Differential pressure objects are used with the differential pressure control mode.
AV 55 and AV 135 are both printed as AbsDiffPressure in the document; check the names read from the device.

integration.summary: Set MV 122 SpSource to Bus, choose the control mode in MV 100 and the flow and power limits, then command AO 1 SpRel from the BMS. Read flow, temperatures, delta T, power and energy for monitoring, and watch MV 99 SummaryStatus and AV 140 ErrorState for faults. If you enable a bus fail action, the BMS must keep rewriting the setpoint inside the watchdog time.

minimum_points.why: Cooling power delivered; units set by MV 124

integration.enable: Write MV 122 SpSource = 2 (Bus) so the valve follows AO 1 SpRel instead of the 0-10 V signal on wire 3. MV 1 Override can force open, close, min, max, nominal or motor stop.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog sets a timeout of 5-3600 s (default 120 s). If no write arrives within that time, the valve runs the action in MV 130 BusFailAction (default None; options Open, Close, Max, Min, Stop) and sets the bus watchdog bit in AV 140. With a fail action set, the BMS must keep rewriting the setpoint.
setup: Default device instance 1; on MS/TP the device ID is this value plus the MAC address.
MS/TP: baud 9600-115200, default 38400; MAC address 0-127, default 1; max 32 nodes per segment without repeater.
BACnet IP: UDP port configurable, default 47808; foreign-device registration supported.
Configure with Belimo Assistant 2 or the valve's built-in web server.
Bus termination (120 Ω) is set with Belimo Assistant 2; BV 99 shows its state.
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 and above are stored persistently; do not write them on a regular schedule.
Changing MV 100 ControlMode resets the valve.
Engineering units change when the unit-select MVs are written; recheck BMS scaling after any change.
Vmax below 25% of nominal flow is raised to 25%.
Avoid switching MV 200 between certified and lifetime registers, it breaks energy trending.
